item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 02/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting southern China is expected to moderate gradually today. Under the influence of a southerly airstream, the weather will improve gradually over the coastal areas of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week and it will be hot during the day. A trough of low pressure will bring showers and thunderstorms to southern China towards the weekend and early next week.

R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
